title: Clarify that candidate worktree cleanup follows item closure
outcome: Clarify the cleanup rule so a candidate worktree is retained through post-landing evaluation and removed only after its item closes.
acceptance: AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md state that the Merger removes a landed candidate worktree only after its item has closed and required run evidence is retained.
The clarification preserves the agreed cleanup rule and existing path, evidence-retention, and authority constraints.
